title: Caterpillar Earnings Preview: Analysts Expect Strong Growth in Q3 2026
excerpt: Caterpillar set to report Q3 earnings with expectations of significant EPS growth.
body:
Caterpillar Inc. is a leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, diesel and natural gas engines, and industrial gas turbines. The company operates through various segments, including Construction Industries, Resource Industries, Energy & Transportation, and Financial Products, each contributing to its robust portfolio.

The company is scheduled to report its fiscal quarter earnings for September 2026 before the market opens today. This quarter is particularly critical as Caterpillar aims to demonstrate resilience amid fluctuating demand in the construction and mining sectors, alongside ongoing supply chain challenges.

Market expectations are high, with analysts consensus EPS forecast set at $7.12, a notable increase from the $4.95 EPS reported in the same quarter last year. Investors will be closely monitoring revenue trends across its segments, particularly in Construction Industries, which has seen varying demand due to economic conditions. Additionally, margin pressures and cost management strategies will be scrutinized, especially in light of rising input costs.

Guidance for future quarters will also be a focal point, as investors seek insights into how Caterpillar plans to navigate potential economic headwinds. Furthermore, any announcements regarding capital returns, including dividends or share buybacks, will be of significant interest. Beyond Caterpillar, this report will provide key insights into the health of the construction and mining sectors, influencing market sentiment and potentially impacting broader indices.
